title: HKCanto-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Cantonese Language Understanding and Cultural Comprehension in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model capabilities on Cantonese-specific linguistic tasks (phonological reasoning, orthographic knowledge, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion) and open-ended NLP tasks to reveal performance gaps and the models' over-reliance on high-resource languages like Mandarin or English.

Measuring model comprehension of Hong Kong-specific cultural knowledge through a manually crafted multiple-choice dataset covering local food culture, history, landmarks, language expressions, and daily life to highlight the under-representation of regional knowledge.
